name: VINCENZA CASTAGNARO
bioAdditions: The San Mango parish burial index has the entry on 24 March 1700 (S1), matching the tree's death date.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Tree data match an indexed San Mango parish entry (derivative index of a primary register; image online but not read by me).

sources.supports: Burial 24 Mar 1700: Vincenza Castagnaro, wife (uxor) of Joseph Maletta (Index entry; the register image is on the same site's Google Drive, linked from https://www.italianparishrecords.org/search-by-region/calabria/catanzaro/san-mango-daquino.)
